WITH line_items_with_products AS (
  SELECT 
    ili.order_item_id,
    ili.product_quantity,
    ili.derived_product_cost,
    ili.derived_total_cost,
    p.product_color
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili
  INNER JOIN Order_Items oi ON ili.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
  INNER JOIN Products p ON ili.product_id = p.product_id
),
group_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    order_item_id,
    product_color,
    AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) as avg_quantity,
    AVG(
      CASE 
        WHEN derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL AND derived_total_cost != 0
        THEN (derived_product_cost - derived_total_cost) / derived_total_cost
      END
    ) as avg_cost_diff_ratio
  FROM line_items_with_products
  GROUP BY order_item_id, product_color
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    order_item_id,
    product_color,
    avg_quantity,
    avg_cost_diff_ratio,
    RANK() OVER (
      PARTITION BY product_color 
      ORDER BY 
        CASE WHEN avg_quantity IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC,
        avg_quantity DESC
    ) as rank
  FROM group_stats
)
SELECT 
  order_item_id,
  product_color,
  avg_quantity,
  avg_cost_diff_ratio,
  rank
FROM ranked
WHERE rank <= 3
ORDER BY product_color, rank
